expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Expands once per complete registered type that can construct, copy, and destruct. Pushes a copied argument into the pending internal reflected-event call. Expands for the same eligible types and pushes a writable reference argument. Stable aliases are also ensured for int32, uint32, float32, and float64. Pushes a copied type-erased argument after runtime type validation. Pushes a writable type-erased reference argument after runtime type validation. Executes the pending argument list against a reflected event on Object. @param Name Reflected event function name. Executes the pending argument list against a single-cast script delegate. Broadcasts the pending argument list through a multicast script delegate. Expands for eligible instance Blueprint events with at most 16 supported arguments. The declaration preserves reflected return, input, output, default, and callable metadata. Expands for eligible static Unreal functions exposed as AngelScript mixins. Receiver supplies the mixin object type while invocation targets the class default object.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
testScope: void __Evt_PushArgument__<TypeName>(const <Type>& Value); | void __Evt_PushArgumentRef__<TypeName>(const <Type>& Value); | void __Evt_PushArgument(const ?& Value); | void __Evt_PushArgumentRef(const ?& Value); | void __Evt_Execute(const UObject Object, const FName& Name); | void __Evt_ExecuteDelegate(const _FScriptDelegate& Delegate); | void __Evt_ExecuteDelegate(const _FMulticastScriptDelegate& Delegate); | ReturnType EventOwner.EventName(Arguments...); | ReturnType Receiver.EventName(Arguments...);
